title: Switch patterns, ranges and where clauses
summary: Classify coordinate tuples with ordered switch patterns, value bindings and a where condition.
code: case let (x, y) where x == y:
triggers: classify structured values with overlapping conditions
prompts: Label a point as an origin, axis, diagonal, nearby point or outlier.
invariant: The first matching case determines the label.
mantra: Match the most specific case before broader patterns.
pitfalls: Placing the range pattern first would consume the origin and nearby axis points.
A wildcard ignores a value; a binding names it for use in a condition.
